description: Copy the app itself prints: status, connectivity, microphone errors, date field labels. It is separate from the forms because it is shared by all three and is not a question. Every entry needs both languages and the same {placeholders} in each.

status.pendingPartner.am: ምዝገባው ደርሷል — በአጋር ማረጋገጫ በመጠባበቅ ላይ
status.pendingPartner.om: Galmeen qaqqabeera — Mirkaneessa tumsaa eegaa jira
status.pendingPartner.ti: ምዝገባ በጺሑ ኣሎ — ብመሻርኽቲ ምርግጋጽ ይጽበ ኣሎ

receipt.pendingPartnerHelp.am: የአጋር ድርጅት ረዳት ምዝገባዎን ለማረጋገጥ በስልክ ቁጥርዎ ይደውልልዎታል።
receipt.pendingPartnerHelp.en: An assistant from a partner organisation will call your phone to verify your registration.
receipt.pendingPartnerHelp.om: Gargaaraan dhaabbata tumsaa galmee keessan mirkaneessuuf bilbila keessanirratti isiniif bilbila.
receipt.pendingPartnerHelp.ti: ሓጋዚ መሻርኽቲ ትካል ምዝገባኹም ንምርግጋጽ ኣብ ስልክኹም ክድውለልኩም እዩ።

file.demoNote.am: በዚህ ሙከራ ውስጥ ፋይሉ አይላክም። ስሙ ብቻ ይታያል።
file.demoNote.en: In this demo the file is not uploaded. Only its name is used.
file.demoNote.om: Yaalii kana keessatti faayilli hin olkaa'amu. Maqaan isaa qofti fayyadama.
file.demoNote.ti: ኣብዚ ፈተነ እዚ እቲ ፋይል ኣይስደድን እዩ። ስሙ ጥራይ እዩ ዝርአ።

announce.offline.am: ግንኙነት የለም። መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ።
announce.offline.en: You are offline. Your answers are being kept on this device.
announce.offline.om: Qunnamtiin hin jiru. Deebiin keessan meeshaa kanarratti qabama.
announce.offline.ti: ርክብ መርበብ የለን። መልስኹም ኣብዚ መሳርሒ ይዕቀብ።

offline.body.am: መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ።
offline.body.en: Your answers are kept on this device and will send themselves when the connection returns.
offline.body.om: Deebiin keessan meeshaa kanarratti qabama; yommuu qunnamtiin deebi'u ofumaan ergama.
offline.body.ti: መልስኹም ኣብዚ መሳርሒ ይዕቀብ፤ ርክብ መርበብ ክመጽእ ከሎ ብባዕሉ ይስደድ።

offline.smsSent.en: A resume link was sent via SMS.
offline.smsSent.om: Hidhaan itti fufiinsaa karaa SMS ergomeera.
offline.smsSent.ti: ናይ ምቕጻል ሊንክ ብኤስኤምኤስ ተሰዲዱ እዩ።

banner.lastSent.en: Your last sign-up was sent. Reference:
banner.lastSent.om: Galmeen keessan inni dhumaa ergameera. Wabii:
banner.lastSent.ti: ናይ መወዳእታ ምዝገባኹም ተላኢኹ እዩ። መወከሲ፦

resume.title.en: You have an unfinished form. Your answers were restored.
resume.title.om: Waraqaa galmee hin xumuramne qabdu. Deebiin keessan deebi'eera.
resume.title.ti: ዘይተዛዘመ ቅጥዒ ኣሎኩም። መልስኹም ተመሊሱ ኣሎ።

review.intro.am: እነዚህን መልሶች ያዳምጡ። ትክክል ካልሆኑ ይቀይሩ።
review.intro.en: Listen to your answers. If something is wrong, change it.
review.intro.om: Deebiiwwan keessan dhaggeeffadhaa. Yoo dogoggorri jiraate jijjiiraa.

review.nextHint.en: If it is right, press Next.

send.storageFull.am: ይህ መሣሪያ ማስቀመጥ አልቻለም። መልሶችዎ አሁንም በዚህ ገጽ ላይ አሉ። እባክዎ ገጹን አይዝጉ።
send.storageFull.en: This device would not store it. Your answers are still on this page — please do not close it.
send.storageFull.om: Meeshaan kun olkaawwachuu hin dandeenye. Deebiin keessan ammallee fuula kanarra jira — mee hin cufinaa.
send.storageFull.ti: እዚ መሳርሒ ክዕቅብ ኣይከኣለን። መልስኹም ሕጂ'ውን ኣብዚ ገጽ ኣሎ — ብኽብረትኩም ኣይትዕጸውዎ።

send.unreachable.am: አገልጋዩን ማግኘት አልቻልንም። መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል እና ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ። ገጹን መዝጋት ይችላሉ።
send.unreachable.en: We could not reach the server. Your answers are saved on this device and will send themselves when the connection comes back. You can close this page.
send.unreachable.om: Sarvarii argachuu hin dandeenye. Deebiin keessan meeshaa kanarratti olkaa'ameera; yommuu qunnamtiin deebi'u ofumaan ergama. Fuula kana cufuu dandeessu.
send.unreachable.ti: ሰርቨር ክርከብ ኣይከኣለን። መልስኹም ኣብዚ መሳርሒ ተዓቂቡ ኣሎ፤ ርክብ ምስ ተመልሰ ብባዕሉ ይስደድ። ነዚ ገጽ ክትዓጽውዎ ትኽእሉ ኢኹም።

send.queued.am: መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል። ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ። ገጹን መዝጋት ይችላሉ።
send.queued.en: Your answers are saved on this device. They will send themselves when the connection returns. You can close this page.
send.queued.om: Deebiin keessan meeshaa kanarratti olkaa'ameera. Yommuu qunnamtiin deebi'u ofumaan ergama. Fuula kana cufuu dandeessu.
send.queued.ti: መልስኹም ኣብዚ መሳርሒ ተዓቂቡ ኣሎ። ርክብ ምስ ተመልሰ ብባዕሉ ይስደድ። ነዚ ገጽ ክትዓጽውዎ ትኽእሉ ኢኹም።

send.rejected.en: The server could not accept these answers.
send.rejected.om: Sarvariin deebiiwwan kana fudhachuu hin dandeenye.

announce.complete.am: ምዝገባው ተጠናቅቋል። የማጣቀሻ ቁጥርዎ {ref}። ይህን ቁጥር ይያዙት።
announce.complete.en: Sign-up complete. Your reference is {ref}. Keep this number.
announce.complete.om: Galmeen xumurameera. Lakkoofsi wabii keessanii {ref} dha. Lakkoofsa kana qabadhaa.
announce.complete.ti: ምዝገባ ተወዲኡ እዩ። ናይ መወከሲ ቍጽርኹም {ref} እዩ። ነዚ ቍጽሪ ሓዝዎ።

announce.pendingPartner.am: ምዝገባው ደርሷል — በአጋር ማረጋገጫ በመጠባበቅ ላይ። የማጣቀሻ ቁጥርዎ {ref}። ረዳት ይደውልልዎታል።
announce.pendingPartner.en: Sign-up received — Pending partner verification. Your reference is {ref}. A helper will call you.
announce.pendingPartner.om: Galmeen qaqqabeera — Mirkaneessa tumsaa eegaa jira. Lakkoofsi wabii {ref} dha. Gargaaraan isiniif bilbila.
announce.pendingPartner.ti: ምዝገባ በጺሑ ኣሎ — ብመሻርኽቲ ምርግጋጽ ይጽበ ኣሎ። ናይ መወከሲ ቍጽርኹም {ref} እዩ። ሓጋዚ ክድውለልኩም እዩ።

voice.noVoice.am: ይህ መሣሪያ በአማርኛ ማንበብ አይችልም። ጽሑፉ ከዚህ በታች አለ።
voice.noVoice.en: This device has no voice for this language. The text is below.
voice.noVoice.om: Meeshaan kun afaan kanaan dubbisuu hin danda'u. Barreeffamni isaa armaan gadi jira.
voice.noVoice.ti: እዚ መሳርሒ በዚ ቋንቋ ከንብብ ኣይክእልን እዩ። ጽሑፉ ኣብ ታሕቲ ኣሎ።

voice.unsupported.am: ድምጽ በዚህ አሳሽ አይሠራም። የስልኩን ማይክሮፎን ይጠቀሙ ወይም ይጻፉ።
voice.unsupported.en: Voice does not work in this browser. Use your keyboard microphone, or type.
voice.unsupported.om: Sagaleen braawzarii kanaan hin hojjetu. Maayikirofoonii kiiyboordii fayyadamaa, yookiin barreessaa.
voice.unsupported.ti: ድምጺ በዚ ብራውዘር ኣይሰርሕን እዩ። ኣብ ኪቦርድ ዘሎ ማይክሮፎን ተጠቐሙ፣ ወይ ጽሓፉ።

voice.pickOne.en: I did not catch that. Pick one:
voice.pickOne.om: Kun naaf hin galle. Kanarraa filadhaa:

voice.privacy.am: ድምጽዎ ወደ ጽሑፍ ለመቀየር ብቻ ወደዚህ አገልጋይ ይላካል፣ ከዚያ ይሰረዛል።
voice.privacy.en: Your voice is sent to this server only to be written down, then deleted.
voice.privacy.om: Sagaleen keessan barreeffamatti jijjiiramuuf qofa gara sarvariitti ergama, sana booda ni haqama.
voice.privacy.ti: ድምጽኹም ናብ ጽሑፍ ንምቕያር ጥራይ ናብ ሰርቨር ይስደድ፣ ድሕሪኡ ይድምሰስ።

voice.buttonsOrType.en: Please use the buttons or type instead.
voice.buttonsOrType.om: Mee qulqullinaan qubsumaan filadhaa yookiin barreessaa.

voice.noEngine.am: በዚህ አገልጋይም የድምጽ መለወጫ አገልግሎት የለም።
voice.noEngine.en: This server also has no transcription service configured, so there is nothing to fall back on.
voice.noEngine.om: Sarvarii kanarras tajaajilli sagalee jijjiiruu hin qophoofne.
voice.noEngine.ti: ኣብዚ ሰርቨር'ውን ኣገልግሎት ምቕያር ድምጺ ኣይተዳለወን።

voice.err.insecure.am: ማይክሮፎኑ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ገጽ ይፈልጋል። ገጹን በhttps ከፍተው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.insecure.en: The microphone needs a secure page. Open this form over https (or on localhost) and try again.
voice.err.insecure.om: Maayikirofooniin fuula eegumsa qabu barbaada. Fuula kana https irratti banaatii irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
voice.err.insecure.ti: ማይክሮፎን ውሑስ ገጽ የድልዮ። ነዚ ገጽ ብ https ከፊቶም ደጊሞም ይፈትኑ።

voice.err.framed.am: ማይክሮፎኑ በተካተተው ገጽ ውስጥ ተከልክሏል። ቅጹን በራሱ ትር ከፍተው ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.framed.en: The microphone is blocked inside an embedded frame. Open the form in its own tab and try again.
voice.err.framed.om: Maayikirofooniin fuula keessatti cufameera. Fuula kana baafata mataa isaatiin banaatii irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
voice.err.framed.ti: ማይክሮፎን ኣብ ውሽጢ ገጽ ተዓጽዩ ኣሎ። ነዚ ገጽ ኣብ ባዕሉ መስኮት ከፊቶም ደጊሞም ይፈትኑ።

voice.err.blocked.am: ማይክሮፎኑ ተከልክሏል። በአድራሻ አሞሌው ላይ የማይክሮፎን ፈቃድ ይስጡ፣ ከዚያ ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.blocked.en: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access for this site in the address bar, then try again.
voice.err.blocked.om: Maayikirofooniin cufameera. Barreeffama teessoo irratti maayikirofooniif heyyama kennaatii irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
voice.err.blocked.ti: ማይክሮፎን ተዓጽዩ ኣሎ። ኣብ ኣድራሻ መስመር ንማይክሮፎን ፍቓድ ሂብኩም ደጊምኩም ፈትኑ።

voice.err.service.am: ይህ ገጽ በድምጽ መስማት እንዲጠቀም አልተፈቀደም። ገጹን በhttps በራሱ ትር ይክፈቱ።
voice.err.service.en: This page is not allowed to use speech recognition — usually a secure-page or embedding restriction. Open the form in its own tab over https.
voice.err.service.om: Fuulli kun sagalee akka hin fayyadamne dhorkameera. Fuula kana https irratti baafata mataa isaatiin banaa.
voice.err.service.ti: እዚ ገጽ ድምጺ ከይጥቀም ተኸልኪሉ ኣሎ። ነዚ ገጽ ብ https ኣብ ባዕሉ መስኮት ክፈትዎ።

voice.err.network.am: በድምጽ መስማት የአሳሹ አገልግሎት ግንኙነት ይፈልጋል፣ እሱም አልተገኘም።
voice.err.network.en: Speech recognition needs a connection to the browser's speech service, and it could not be reached.
voice.err.network.om: Sagaleedhaan hubachuun qunnamtii tajaajila braawzarii barbaada, inni immoo hin argamne.
voice.err.network.ti: ድምጺ ንምርዳእ ርክብ ኣገልግሎት ብራውዘር የድሊ፣ ንሱ ድማ ኣይተረኽበን።

voice.err.noMic.en: No microphone was found on this device.

voice.err.noModel.en: The browser has no speech model for {langs}.
voice.err.noModel.om: Braawzariin kun moodeela sagalee {langs} hin qabu.
voice.err.noModel.ti: እዚ ብራውዘር ናይ {langs} ድምጺ ሞዴል የብሉን።

voice.err.unknown.en: Speech input did not start on this device.
voice.err.unknown.om: Galchi sagalee meeshaa kanarratti hin eegalle.
voice.err.unknown.ti: ናይ ድምጺ እታዎት ኣብዚ መሳርሒ ኣይተጀመረን።

sent.supportHidden.am: የእርዳታ መልሶች በዚህ ዝርዝር ውስጥ የሉም።
sent.supportHidden.en: The support answers are not in this payload — they never left the phone.
sent.supportHidden.om: Deebiin gargaarsaa tarree kana keessa hin jiru — bilbila kana keessaa matumaa hin baane.
sent.supportHidden.ti: ናይ ሓገዝ መልሲ ኣብዚ ዝርዝር የለን — ካብዚ ስልኪ ፈጺሙ ኣይወጸን።
